remarks: Set gracefully above the scenic Goodwives River, this exceptional 1930s stone residence blends timeless character with 3403sq ft of sophisticated modern updates. Fully restored and renovated in 2003, the home preserves its architectural integrity with casement windows, slate roof, 9ft ceilings, and dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplcs. 2020 improv include refinished hardwood floors throughout, a renovated primary bath with new shower and vanity, custom built-ins and window bench seating in the primary bedroom, enhanced third-floor suite storage and closet space, and a refreshed lower level with built-in office workspace and laundry area. The chef's kitchen features Carrara marble countertops, center island, premium appliances, wine refrigerator, and opens seamlessly to the family room with coffered ceiling and fireplace-ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a private sanctuary with fireplace, sitting room, and spa-inspired bath featuring dbl vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower. Addl bedrooms are ensuite with updated baths. A sun-filled living room with windows on three sides overlooks the grounds and includes a wet bar with direct access to the patio and deck for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Set on over one acre of fully fenced property, offers privacy and gated access leading to Gorham's Pond-perfect for kayak, paddle, and recreation.
